answer:
Let \(n\) satisfy:
\[
n \equiv 3 \pmod{13},\quad n \equiv 11 \pmod{16},\quad n \equiv 5 \pmod{17}
\]

From \(n=3+13a\), mod 16 gives:
\[
3+13a \equiv 11 \pmod{16}
\]
\[
13a \equiv 8 \pmod{16}
\]
\[
a \equiv 8 \pmod{16}
\]
So \(a=8+16b\), hence:
\[
n=3+13(8+16b)=107+208b
\]

Now mod 17:
\[
107+208b \equiv 5 \pmod{17}
\]
\[
5+4b \equiv 5 \pmod{17}
\]
\[
4b \equiv 0 \pmod{17}
\]
\[
b \equiv 0 \pmod{17}
\]

Thus the smallest positive solution is:
\[
n=107
\]

FINAL: 107
